speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand the cause of your acute diarrhea, please describe your symptoms, including how long you have been ill, if you have a fever, and whether you have experienced blood in your stool.

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your recent treatment with levofloxacin for pneumonia, I suspect this may be antibiotic-associated colitis. Have you noticed any blood or mucus in your stool, and are you experiencing significant rectal pain?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Watery diarrhea. I also have Lower abdominal discomfort, Abdominal cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-Associated Colitis (C. difficile infection)
